extensions.tonalRampPolicy: Eight-step OKLCH ramps are synthesized display metadata, preserving each extracted hue and chroma. They are not additional implemented color tokens.

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Persistent real route links with one moving selection background, intent prefetch, loading feedback and visible keyboard focus. Static preview shows the resting state.
components.html: HomePublicationsExperienceHonors & Talks
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--profile-display, "Manrope", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif); } .ds-nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 15px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; color: var(--profile-muted, #4c657a); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[data-pending] { background: #f3f7fb; color: var(--profile-link, #245b87); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { background: #e5eff8; color: var(--profile-link, #245b87); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--profile-link, #245b87); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 3px; } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0 3px; } .ds-nav a { padding: 7px 10px; font-size: 12px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav a { transition: none; } }

components.css: .ds-intro { container-type: inline-size; padding: 26px 30px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--profile-wash, #edf5fc); color: var(--profile-ink, #203b53); font-family: "Source Sans 3", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-intro h2 { margin: 0 0 16px; font-family: var(--profile-display, "Manrope", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif); font-size: clamp(20px, 2.8cqi, 28px); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.025em; text-wrap: wrap; } .ds-intro p { max-width: none; margin: 0; } .ds-intro strong { font-weight: 600; } @media (max-width: 759px) { .ds-intro { container-type: inline-size; padding: 22px; } } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-intro { container-type: inline-size; padding: 18px; font-size: 16px; } .ds-intro h2 { font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.35; } }

components.css: .ds-archive { margin-top: 0.5rem; color: var(--profile-ink, #203b53); font-family: "Source Sans 3", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; font-size: 17px; } .ds-archive summary { width: fit-content; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.65rem 0; color: var(--profile-link, #245b87); cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.875rem; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-archive summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--profile-link, #245b87); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-archive ul { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-archive li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5.5rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 1rem; padding: 0.55rem 0; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-archive time { color: var(--profile-muted, #4c657a); font-size: 0.9rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-archive { font-size: 16px; } .ds-archive li { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 3px; padding: 10px 0; } }

narrative.northStar: A stable researcher identity beside changing academic content.
narrative.overview:
The user-selected blue profile direction pairs a pale identity rail with a white reading surface. The atmosphere is restrained and readable: identity remains visible while academic material moves through the right pane. Existing portraits, laboratory and institution marks, and research figures provide the imagery.

The shared shell and homepage use the new type pairing. Record interiors retain their established typography. User-approved refinements compact Publications and Experience; Honors & Talks retains its established layout.

At 1176px the intro uses its full inner width and one heading line. Background/goal columns use 2.6:1 with aligned heading tops and paragraph bottoms. Publications use venue/resource metadata rows. Compact education reads date, institution, degree, location, naturally stacking at759px.

Typography refinement: publication venues16px; Home titles17px with16px summaries, record titles15px with14px authors. Authors use1.35 line-height; Multimodal Emotion Recognition is not abbreviated.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent identity and navigation across four public routes.
Pale blue tonal surfaces, blue links, and fine dividers.
Manrope identity, Source Sans 3 homepage reading, and retained Trebuchet record interiors.
Original academic imagery and inline affiliation and citation assets.
dos: Do preserve the persistent header and identity rail while only the right pane scrolls and changes.
Do scope the new reading type to Home; retain record-page typography and the approved compact publication and education layouts.
Do preserve original figures, author portrait, inline laboratory logo, and dynamic Scholar citation badge.
Do keep all five profile links usable in mobile and compact landscape layouts.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, native URLs, browser history, loading announcements, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't turn the identity rail into a full-width scrolling banner.
Don't add raised card shadows to the flat homepage surfaces and research figures.
Don't replace the dynamic citation badge with a static citation count.
